title: Equivariant tilting induces a coherent factorization-category equivalence under proper quotient descent, reductive quotient, and finite resolution hypotheses
author: Yuki Hirano
work: Equivariant Tilting Modules, Pfaffian Varieties and Noncommutative Matrix Factorizations
source_version: Official SIGMA 17 (2021) article 055, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2021.055; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof transports a tilting adjunction through character-twisted potentials and H-invariant endomorphism descent. Its core establishes factorization equivalence using injective resolutions, truncation telescopes and projective generators, then lifts the result through faithful equivariant restriction with a split adjunction. Coherence and proper quotient descent are essential to restricting this construction from larger derived categories.

Standard bounded tilting full faithfulness is explicitly cited to Happel after the Add(T)-projective construction; standard factorization totalization and lifting results are identified prior background. Only part (2) is selected; the partial-tilting branch and Pfaffian applications are not separate claims. retained_original_metadata.statement_scope: Theorem 4.7(2), over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero: X separated finite type, G affine algebraic, H closed normal, A a G-equivariant coherent X-algebra; R normal finite type with H acting trivially on Spec R; f equivariant with f_*O_X=R and [X/H]->Spec R proper. T is (G,H)-tilting, G/H reductive, Lambda^H finite global dimension, and every object of Qcoh(A) has a finite injective resolution there. For a character chi of G/H and invariant chi-twisted potential w_R with pulled-back w, RF is the displayed equivalence of coherent equivariant factorization categories. H is not assumed to act trivially on X.
